question: Which month in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes for customers and subscribers?	Which month (in number) in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes (in thousands) for customers and subscribers, based on the trip end dates in the San Francisco bikeshare data?
sql:
WITH monthly_minutes AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM end_date) AS month,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(duration_sec) / 60.0 AS total_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM end_date) = 2017
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Subscriber', 'Customer')
  GROUP BY month, subscriber_type
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(total_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY subscriber_type ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_minutes
  FROM monthly_minutes
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN cumulative_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS customer_cumulative,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN cumulative_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS subscriber_cumulative
  FROM cumulative
  GROUP BY month
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8
  UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
)
SELECT 
  am.month,
  COALESCE(p.customer_cumulative, 0) AS customer_cumulative,
  COALESCE(p.subscriber_cumulative, 0) AS subscriber_cumulative,
  ABS(COALESCE(p.customer_cumulative, 0) - COALESCE(p.subscriber_cumulative, 0)) / 1000.0 AS abs_diff_thousands
FROM all_months am
LEFT JOIN pivoted p ON am.month = p.month
ORDER BY am.month
